difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if O_S -> A_0 is integral and A is of finite type as an A_0-algebra, then the relative Proj p : Proj_S(A) -> S is universally closed (source lines 7715-7726). The proof reduces to S affine, factors p as X -> Spec(A_0) -> Spec(R), uses that an integral ring map gives a universally closed morphism for the second factor, and shows that Proj(A) -> Spec(A_0) is quasi-compact and satisfies the existence part of the valuative criterion, hence is universally closed; the claim follows since universally closed morphisms compose.
